product.description: Admiratoare infocată a serialului SF Starfield și autoare a unui blog dedicat fanilor de pretutindeni, Elle a fost mereu o ciudată pentru cei din jur. Inclusiv pentru fata cu părul verde cu care lucrează la Dovleacul Magic, o rulotă cam rablagită cu macirc;ncare vegană. Atunci cacirc;nd află de concursul de cosplay de la ExcelsiCon, convenția inființată de tatăl ei cu puțin timp inainte să moară, Elle e hotăracirc;tă să participe pentru a-și indeplini un vis mai vechi: să plece cacirc;t mai departe de mama sa vitregă și fiicele ei răutăcioase, care ii fac viața un coșmar. Deși pregătirile pentru concurs nu sunt deloc ușoare, Elle va descoperi treptat că, atunci cacirc;nd ai prieteni adevărați și o dorință arzătoare, stelele sunt mai aproape, iar basmele pot deveni realitate cacirc;nd te aștepți mai puțin. bdquo;Cu personaje adorabile, un serial SF intre Star Trek și Firefly, un concurs de cosplay și o nașă fermecată răsărită dintr-o rulotă cu macirc;ncare, Geekerella e o scrisoare de dragoste adresată fanilor de orice fel din lumea intreagă.ldquo; ndash; Booklist

# Geekerella: Cinderella at the Sci-Fi Convention â A Must-Read Sci-Fi Novel

Are you ready for a blend of high fantasy, thrilling science fiction, and heartwarming romance? *Geekerella* is an enchanting novel that captures the spirit of fandom, magic, and self-discovery. Perfect for fans who love the expansive worlds found in series like Star Trek or Firefly, this book invites readers into a vibrant universe where sci-fi conventions meet genuine magic.

## About Geekerella: The Story

Elle has always been an unconventional soulâa charming oddity to those around her. She is deeply immersed in fandom culture, maintaining a blog dedicated to true fans of all types. Her life is complicated, involving everything from working with a green-haired associate on a magical cauldron (Dovleacul Magic) to navigating the messy dynamics of family expectations.

When she learns about the cosplay competition at ExcelsiConâa convention founded by her father shortly before his passingâElle feels compelled to participate. This isn't just about a hobby; it is her chance to fulfill a long-held dream, an escape from the life with her "glittering" mother and troublesome sisters that has become a daily ordeal.

## A Convergence of Worlds: Science Fiction Meets Magic

The preparations for the cosplay contest are anything but simple. As Elle dives into the world of fandom, she begins to realize that sometimes, the most unbelievable thingsâtrue friendship and burning desireâare enough to prove that **the stars are closer than you think**, and magic can materialize when you least expect it.

*Geekerella* masterfully blends genres:
*   **Sci-Fi Adventure:** Drawing comparisons to beloved franchises like Starfield.
*   **Fantasy Romance:** Featuring adorable characters, magical elements, and the allure of a mysterious wand.
*   **Fandom Heart:** It is described as a love letter to every type of fan in the world.

If you enjoy stories that celebrate community, passion for fandom culture, and the magic found between genres, this captivating read will pull you right into its orbit.
